# conative_azuresql_database_users (Data Source)

Lists the users of a database, optionally filtered. An empty result is not an error. The built-in principals `public`, `dbo`, `guest`, `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` and `sys` are not listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the external users of a database. An empty list is not an error, so this
# can be used to check whether something exists.
data "conative_azuresql_database_users" "external" {
  database       = "orders"
  principal_type = "EXTERNAL_USER" # optional
  # name         = "orders-app"    # optional, exact match
}

output "has_app" {
  value = length(data.conative_azuresql_database_users.external.users) > 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database name.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the user with exactly this name.
- `principal_type` (String) Return only users of this principal type, as the database reports it: ASYMMETRIC_KEY_MAPPED_USER, CERTIFICATE_MAPPED_USER, EXTERNAL_GROUP, EXTERNAL_USER, SQL_USER, WINDOWS_GROUP, WINDOWS_USER.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The database name.
- `users` (Attributes List) The matching users, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `entra_id` (String) The Entra ID the security identifier was derived from, or null when it cannot be derived.
- `name` (String) User name.
- `principal_type` (String) The principal type as reported by the database.
- `sid` (String) The security identifier as `0x` followed by hexadecimal digits.
